desc:
Welcome to Bakso Gacoan Tower! 🧆

Climb your way to the top through a tower filled with delicious meatballs, hilarious obstacles, and unexpected surprises!

🍜 Fun & Easy Tower: Enjoy a beginner-friendly obby that everyone can play!
🧆 Unique Obstacles: Jump, dodge, and overcome funny challenges themed around meatballs (bakso)!
🤣 Funny Moments: Discover silly surprises and hilarious obstacles along the way!
🎁 Free Avatars: Try out awesome free avatars and show off your style!
👫 Play With Friends: Race your friends and see who can reach the top first!

✅ Join our Sahabat Productions Tower community and like the game to unlock a Double Jump Coil and a FREE /shortcut!

Scripter: GD_RuffyArz
Builders: GD_RuffyArz & marcell_HDx

Big thanks: GD_Dhika & GD_Davin

🎯 Can you reach the top of Bakso Gacoan Tower?
Only the fastest will survive!

⚙️ Shutdown = Game Update!
